name: draft-before
expression: (async()=>{if(document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Stop assistant response"]'))throw Error('Another turn active');const {useStudio}=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');return {job:useStudio.getState().job};})()

name: compose-explicit-fixture
expression: (()=>{const select=document.querySelector('select[aria-label="Assistant permissions"]');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set.call(select,'readonly');select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));const box=document.querySelector('textarea');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set.call(box,'Run calculate_draft_roof_area for this explicit QA supplied fixture now. This is draft arithmetic, not source-backed takeoff. One plane id qa-roof-3-4-5; gross horizontal plan area 80 m²; pitch 36.86989764584402 degrees from horizontal; measurementReference QA supplied synthetic 10 m by 8 m horizontal plane; pitchReference QA supplied synthetic 3 m rise per 4 m horizontal run. One opening id qa-skylight with horizontal plan area 4 m² and measurementReference QA supplied synthetic 2 m by 2 m horizontal opening. Execute the actual tool, report gross/opening/net true areas and draft/quote eligibility, and finish with a concise Developer review based on the actual result. Do not draw, save, import, calibrate or change any project data.');box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));return {permission:select.value};})()

name: send-once
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const check=()=>{const b=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Send assistant message"]');if(b&&!b.disabled){observer.disconnect();clearTimeout(timer);b.click();resolve('Clicked Send once');}};const observer=new MutationObserver(check);observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,attributes:true,childList:true});const timer=setTimeout(()=>{observer.disconnect();reject(Error('Send never enabled'));},5000);check();})
